type: Runtime transform and vector-FX animation, not frame-by-frame raster strips

embark.event: Commit rule command first; crossfade rider avatar to vessel

disembark.event: Commit legal coast landing first; crossfade vessel to rider

boarding.event: Hold vessels stationary during tactical scene transition

hit.event: Presentation cue only; no new persistent hull HP implied

sinking.event: After confirmed defeat; fade old hull to wreck then remove; do not delay logical defeat

flag.identity: Existing hero portrait medallion/name on inspection; not new heraldry
flag.mirrorPolicy: Mirror only ship art; transform flag anchor x→1−x and never mirror text or portrait
flag.emptyShip: No hero flag, owner/neutral marker only

wagon.method: Directional painted token with gentle cart bob and position tween; no anatomical horse gait frames

catapult.fire: Reuse fx.siege.catapult.throw 8frames256x256,12fps; runtime origin/flip from registered engine anchor
catapult.projectile: Reuse stone asset; projectile arrival synchronized to committed hit event

reducedMotion: Disable bob, roll, wake and shaking; preserve state changes and readable ownership
timeSource: Presentation elapsed milliseconds only; all actions/gameplay resolved in deterministic rules before playback
